お尋ね者になっちまって、捕まったら縛り首なんだ。
text.official_en:
Hey, c'mon! Let me into your crew. I've got the law
on my tail. I'll hang if they catch up.

捕まったら縛り首なんだ。
text.official_en:
Hey, c'mon! You gotta let me into your crew. The
law's on my tail. I'll hang if they catch me!

人助けと思って匿ってくれ！
text.official_en:
I ain't picky about work, and I don't cause no trouble.
Do a good deed! Get me outta here!

責任取って匿えよ！

It's your fault I've come to this! I ain't kidding! You
gotta do right by me now. Get me outta here!

おかげで寿命が延びたぜ……
text.official_en:
I won't forget this. I've got more time this side of
the boneyard, thanks to you.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キロイカ

当たり前だ、馬鹿野郎。
むざむざ死ぬなんざ御免だからな。
text.official_en:
Course you will, you briny rump of a sea beast!
I ain't goin' easy, not without a fight!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キロイカ

これから頼むぜ、隠れ蓑としてもな！
text.official_en:
You can count on Kiroc the Rukh! I'll be countin' on
you too. Been lookin' for a safe place to roost!

No, not today, not ever. I'll follow your orders, long
as I can count on you. Need a safe place to roost!

Why in the infernal fathoms not?! I ain't gonna
take no for an answer!

何でだよ、この人でなしめ！
手前なんざ埋められちまえ！
text.official_en:
Why in the watery hells not, you salty scoundrel?
It's YOU who should be worm dirt by now!

おお～！　心の友よ！
text.official_en:
I've lost all I got, and you're throwin' me a lifeline...
Friend! Dearest friend!

この、海賊以下のど外道がああ！！
text.official_en:
Talimun?! You ruined me AND my ship! You're
worse than a pirate, you filthy sea scum!

text.official_en:
Wait! Is this about the bounty on me? You're goin'
to turn me in to the temples! Well, NO you ain't!

I'd rather dance with every waterlogged ghost in a
thousand leagues than see YOU. Get outta here!

You know all about me, eh? Kiroc the Rukh! Captain
of the Black-Swan Pirates, terror of the Danann Sea!

You know all about me, eh? Kiroc the Rukh! Captain
of the Blackbird Pirates, terror of the Danann Sea!

You dripping barnacle! Bet you can't forget ME,
Kiroc the Rukh—captain of the Black-Swan Pirates!
text.real_en:
You dripping barnacle! Bet you can't forget ME,
Kiroc the Rukh—captain of the Blackbird Pirates!

by THAT guy... Now I'm just a nobody crook here.

and thorough. I'm just a nobody crook here.

ever since, I see terrifying ghosts, even by day...

They show up when I least expect it...
